title: Fast keyboard typing
notes: 25 s bed; use the 3 s slice 11.98-14.98 s (densest: 8.7 keystrokes/s). Quiet (-29 LUFS): add ~10-12 dB. Dominant bin 51 Hz = mains hum, high-pass at 120 Hz. One loud stray key at 11.76 s sits just before the slice. Layer with typing_2 offset for 'several terminals'.

title: Keyboard typing
notes: 26 s bed; densest 3 s slice 13.37-16.37 s (9.0 keystrokes/s). Brighter than typing_1 (28.6% >6 kHz). Second layer for a multi-terminal feel.

title: Bass rumble hum
notes: Low drone, starts at full level (2 ms lead-in), level holds within 3 dB for the first 4 s: use 0-3.5 s. 82% of energy <150 Hz (fundamental ~30 Hz): nearly inaudible on laptop/phone speakers, layer with tension_2.

title: Horror synth tension
notes: Mid-range synth tension (centroid 1.05 kHz, only 2% <150 Hz) - the one tension bed that survives small speakers. Swells in over 4 s; use 4.4-8.4 s (steadiest loud section, 5.6 dB spread). Title says 'horror': could be too eerie, unheard.

title: Digital glitch break
notes: Glitch variant for the 'stuck terminal' moment: 0.56 s, instant attack (peak at 17 ms), mid-band (centroid 1.2 kHz), not hissy.

title: Tech device glitch
notes: Glitch variant, 1.1 s stutter with 3 bursts, ends abruptly at 1.12 s; 42% <150 Hz.

title: Click error
notes: 0.29 s error blip, attack 3 ms, peak at 13 ms, low-mid (centroid 586 Hz), no hiss.

title: Sci-Fi error alert
notes: 0.60 s error tone (top of the wanted range), 92 ms attack, peak at 187 ms; louder (-13 LUFS).

title: Cinematic trailer riser
notes: Clean monotonic riser: level climbs ~60 dB over the whole 2.58 s file and the file ENDS at the peak (2535 ms) - put the cut at 2535 ms. Low-heavy (65% <150 Hz) and quiet (peak -6.3 dBFS): add gain, layer riser_3 for air.

title: Vacuum swoosh transition
notes: Suck-in: rises ~1.2 s to the peak at 1571 ms, then collapses 30 dB in 0.3 s. 78% <150 Hz.

title: Swirling whoosh
notes: Bright air riser (centroid 4.1 kHz): rises 1.4 s to 1972 ms then drops 45 dB in 0.3 s. Complements riser_1 (low). Peak at 1972 ms = cut point.

title: Cinematic impact echo
notes: LOGO HIT. Deep boom: onset 98 ms, peak 182 ms (81 ms rise), 90% <150 Hz, holds ~1.6 s then a 7 s decaying tail with echo repeats (1.8-2.8 s). Sub-only: layer a mid element (whoosh/sub_drop_1) for small speakers.

title: Big cinematic impact
notes: END-CARD HIT. Built-in 2 s reverse swell into the hit: peak at 2172 ms (start the file 2.17 s before the frame), then a 5 s tail. 83% <150 Hz.

title: Drum deep impact
notes: Tight deep drum hit: peak at 170 ms, 10 ms rise, smooth natural decay (-40 dB at 1.5 s). More upper content than the others (67% <150 Hz, centroid 165 Hz).

title: Movie trailer synth impact
notes: Braam-style sustained synth hit, not a decaying boom: instant attack (peak 23 ms), level holds ~-10 dB RMS for 4.2 s, ends at 5.2 s. 85% <150 Hz.

title: Apocalyptic stomp impact
notes: Closest to a downer: low-band pitch falls 88 -> 40 Hz over the first 0.7 s, 1.9 s long, loud (-10 LUFS), has harmonics (centroid 327 Hz) so it reads on small speakers. Second bloom at 1.34 s. Titled 'stomp impact', not a pure sine drop.

title: Short bass hit
notes: True short sub drop: pitch 56 -> 24 Hz in 0.3 s, 0.41 s long. Pure sub (centroid 37 Hz): felt on full-range systems only.

title: Synthetic power bass transition
notes: Sustained 61 Hz bass note (no pitch fall), instant attack, 4.7 s decay. Use as a sub bed under the logo, not as a drop.

title: Magical light sweep
notes: Bright sweep (78% >6 kHz): whisper build from 0.5 s, bloom at 1.4-1.6 s (peak 1602 ms), decays to ~2.6 s. Quiet (peak -7 dBFS): add gain. 'Magical' in title - could read as fairy-tale, unheard.

title: Magic sparkle touch
notes: Shorter sparkle: bloom at 0.45 s (peak 476 ms), gone by 1.35 s; 88% >6 kHz.

title: Fast whoosh transition
notes: 0.46 s whoosh-IN: rises to the peak at 722 ms and is cut dead at 0.76 s - end it on the cut. Mid-bright (centroid 3.4 kHz). 301 ms lead-in.

title: Fast air sweep transition
notes: 0.55 s symmetric pass, peak 326 ms, low-mid air (centroid 503 Hz, 33% <150 Hz).

title: Quick swoosh
notes: 0.43 s whoosh-OUT: starts at full level (5 ms lead-in), decays in 0.4 s. Centroid 770 Hz, no hiss.

title: Cinematic transition wind swoosh
notes: 0.69 s wind swoosh, fast 72 ms rise, peak 309 ms, centroid 765 Hz.

title: Fast small sweep transition
notes: 0.44 s deep sweep (82% <150 Hz), peak 296 ms. Weight for heavier cuts; weak on small speakers.

title: Fast sweep transition
notes: 0.40 s bright air sweep (centroid 6.0 kHz, 46% >6 kHz), peak 488 ms, 278 ms lead-in. Quiet (peak -5.9 dBFS).

title: Cinematic whoosh fast transition
notes: 0.87 s (at the length limit) whoosh-in that climbs to 1077 ms and is cut at 1.2 s; doubles as a mini riser.

title: Fast air transition sweep
notes: 0.31 s bright air sweep (50% >6 kHz), peak 489 ms, 310 ms lead-in.

title: Fast sweeping transition
notes: 1.19 s pass: peak at 446 ms then a smooth 0.9 s decay. Mid (centroid 1.36 kHz), no hiss. Peak exactly 0.0 dBFS, not flat-topped.

title: Air woosh
notes: 0.88 s air pass: 0.4 s rise to the peak at 713 ms, 0.5 s decay. Deep (75% <150 Hz).

title: Cinematic muddy swoosh
notes: 1.25 s mid-rich swoosh (centroid 922 Hz), fast attack, peak 411 ms. Decoded peak +0.65 dBFS (no flat-topping): pull down 2 dB before mixing.

title: Keyboard  key presses
notes: Three real key presses at 10, 220 and 439 ms (each ~100 ms, equal level): slice them for three variants. Centroid 1.8 kHz, 1% >6 kHz.

title: Digital typewriter
notes: Stream of 16 identical digital type ticks every ~110 ms (first at 2 ms): slice one tick, or use the 1.7 s run as-is. Centroid 2.6 kHz, 3% >6 kHz.

title: Typing on an electronic device
notes: 21 UI type ticks with irregular human-like timing over 3.5 s - a ready-made 'typing in a prompt box' run. 22% >6 kHz.

title: Classic click
notes: 80 ms click, peak at 135 ms (98 ms lead-in), centroid 4.5 kHz, 28% >6 kHz. Decoded peak +0.12 dBFS (no flat-topping): trim 1 dB.

title: Interface click
notes: Softer, darker click (centroid 1.3 kHz, 4% >6 kHz), 120 ms, peak at 176 ms (170 ms lead-in). Very quiet (peak -10 dBFS): add ~9 dB.

title: Explainer video pops whoosh light pop
notes: 0.14 s whoosh-pop (whole file is 0.18 s), peak at 36 ms, centroid 865 Hz, no hiss.

title: Elevating swoosh
notes: 0.38 s upward swoosh (low-band pitch rises 291 -> 334 Hz), peak 145 ms, zero energy >6 kHz or <150 Hz. Loud: pull down.

title: Hard pop click
notes: 70 ms pop, peak at 44 ms, centroid 710 Hz, no hiss.

title: Long pop
notes: Very short (25 ms) pop, peak at 35 ms, centroid 648 Hz. Slightly lower pitch than pop_1.

title: Dry pop up notification alert
notes: Double pop (events at 35 and 126 ms), 0.19 s.

title: Poker card placement
notes: Card placed on a table: 30 ms tick, peak at 20 ms, centroid 3.2 kHz, 8% >6 kHz. Thin: layer card_2 for weight.

title: Light impact on the ground
notes: Soft thud: 60 ms, peak at 6 ms, centroid 1.0 kHz, no hiss, no sub.

title: Paper slide
notes: Paper slide, 0.37 s, peak at 359 ms (the slide ends on its loudest point); 33% <150 Hz.

title: Modern click box check
notes: 'Box check' tick: 70 ms, peak at 102 ms (98 ms lead-in), centroid 652 Hz, no hiss. Quiet (peak -10 dBFS): add gain.

title: Modern technology select
notes: 20 ms select tick, peak at 15 ms, centroid 2.0 kHz.

title: Relaxing bell chime
notes: Single soft bell: peak at 73 ms, 0.9 s ring, dominant 2954 Hz (~F#7). Quiet (-22 LUFS): add 6-8 dB. Check its pitch against the music before the final mix.

title: Achievement bell
notes: Bell ding, 0.73 s, dominant 1568 Hz (G6), slower 113 ms attack, louder.

title: Success software tone
notes: Soft software tone, 0.67 s, swells in (253 ms attack), dominant 524 Hz (C5), no highs. Least bell-like.

title: Masking the Masters
notes: RECOMMENDED. 100.0 BPM (bar = 2.400 s, beats at 0.052 + 0.600k), so 14 bars = 33.6 s. Quiet pulse for 14 s (-27 -> -21 LUFS-M), staged build one layer per bar from 14.45 s, full level at 21.65 s (-11), holds to the break at ~38.5 s, quieter middle, re-entry 40.85/43.25 s. Window 4.85-38.45 s = 14 bars ending on the break; logo hit lands at film 16.8 s. Rule: music start = 21.65 - (film time of the logo hit), snapped to 2.4 s bars (e.g. start 9.65 s puts the drop at film 12.0 s). First 5 s are quiet (-26) by design, not silent. Decoded peak +0.26 dBFS: trim 1 dB.
author: Eugenio Mininni

title: Odd Beats 01
notes: ~117 BPM (beat 0.513 s). 8-bar intro, level dips at 13.3-16.4 s, then a hard drop at 16.43 s (+10 dB overall, +29 dB in the 30-150 Hz band) and a steady -11..-13 groove after. Window 0-35 s puts the drop at film 16.4 s; start at 4.12 s for a drop at 12.3 s. Only 95 s long. Tagged 'Disturbing': may be too odd, unheard.
author: Lily J

title: Xceed Thru Johann
notes: 86.0 BPM. No drop: a smooth continuous ramp from -16 to -10 LUFS-M over the first 35 s (largest single step +2.4 dB at 8.75 s). Safest underscore if the SFX carry the hits; least dramatic. Decoded peak +0.6 dBFS: trim 1.5 dB.
author: Eugenio Mininni
